ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the figure “Changes along the course in the multi-year average sediment transport volume and runoff volume of the Tarim River,” and answer the following questions. <image1> What does the water source of the source-flow area of the Tarim River mainly come from?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic showing changes in the Tarim River along the river-channel distance. The top marks “Tarim River main stream 1321km,” the left side marks “source-flow area,” and after that are, in order, upper reaches, middle reaches, and lower reaches; the vertical axis represents multi-year average sediment transport volume and multi-year average runoff volume, and the horizontal axis is distance/km. In the figure, runoff volume is relatively high near the source-flow area, and after entering the main stream, it generally decreases along the course. Reasoning: This indicates that the water volume of the Tarim River is mainly replenished in the upstream source-flow area, and gradually decreases toward the downstream due to evaporation, seepage, and water use, etc. Combined with the geographical knowledge that the Tarim River is located in the arid inland area of northwest China, and that its source flows mostly come from high mountain areas such as the Tianshan Mountains and Kunlun Mountains, the water source of its source-flow area mainly comes from meltwater of alpine glaciers and accumulated snow.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the figure “Changes along the course in the multi-year average sediment transport volume and runoff volume of the Tarim River,” and answer the following questions.

<image1>

What does the water source of the source-flow area of the Tarim River mainly come from?

method.method_draft: 先读图像：图题和坐标显示这是塔里木河多年平均输沙量、径流量沿河道距离变化图，左侧标出“源流区”，河流进入干流后径流量总体沿程递减，说明水量主要在上游源流区补给，向下游因蒸发、渗漏和用水而减少。再读题干：问题直接询问“塔里木河的源流区水源主要来自什么”。结合地理知识：塔里木河位于我国西北内陆干旱区，源流来自天山、昆仑山等高山，降水少，河流补给以高山冰川和积雪融化水为主。因此回答：冰雪融水。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中为塔里木河沿河道距离变化示意，顶部标出“塔里木河干流1321km”，左侧标出“源流区”，之后依次为上游、中游、下游；纵轴表示多年平均输沙量和多年平均径流量，横轴为距离/km。图中径流量在源流区附近较高，进入干流后总体沿程递减。推理：这说明塔里木河水量主要在上游源流区获得补给，向下游因蒸发、渗漏和用水等逐渐减少。结合塔里木河位于我国西北内陆干旱区、源流多来自天山和昆仑山等高山地区的地理知识，其源流区水源主要来自高山冰川和积雪融化水。
